steps.note: S1.1.1 states the row-by-row accounting (subtract Ja+Rc, change scratch to a+Vx, c+Gx, add R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx), restore c,a) and the net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, quoting line 744.
S1.1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, and self coefficient one, quoting line 752.
S1.1.2 gives the complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 with the side cancelling intersections zero and two, as at lines 756-758.
S1.1.3 states the inverse schedule X <- X-Y and the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), each restoring its auxiliary wires, quoting line 761.

The plan only says to 'tabulate the orthogonal residual of every edge' (S1.3 method) and refers to 'the residual table' (S1.3.4); no per-edge residual (e.g. B tensor t_X-perp, P tensor F) or its dimension is stated.
S1.3.1 states neighboring triple lines are orthogonal, but the plan never treats the side edge 2->5, the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y-perp, or the complement <t_X,t_Y>-perp of dimension h-2.
S1.3.4 states the only decreasing edge is center 3->4 removing dimension h, gate telescoping, sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N, and absolute Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, quoting line 1061.

S1.3.5 only adds a parenthetical that every nonzero residual 'contains a norm-one vector, hence has an orthonormal basis', under a quote from line 1105; it omits the nondegeneracy of residuals and the argument (exhibiting unit vectors, absorbing alternating planes), so the result is asserted without the sub-step.
S1.3.5 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, quoting line 1105.

S1.3.7 and S3.1 assert that each edge's frame change is a product of translation kernels over an orthonormal residual basis, but never state additivity of weight mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors or q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x].
The plan asserts the resulting kernel aI+bX_v (or inverse) but not that wt(v) is odd, the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, or the conversion via H diag(1,-1) H = X.

S1.3.7 states one kernel per residual basis vector with total s_c and that the assertion extends to any number of columns by tensor products; S3.1.2 and S3.1.4 make each residual vector one tensored factor (C^{eps_h})^{tensor f}, s_c in all.

S3.1.4 and S3.1 give the Z_{a,f} sign repair with i^{27f}, C^{-1}=-iZCZ, and negating the bank, but the plan never states the endpoint frames (I for the zero label, C^{tensor m} for the full label) or that X_a->Y_a carries C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), so what is repaired and why is missing.
S1.3.5 states both loss ratios are below 1/2, S1.3.6 states the deficit N-2L_b>0, and S1.3 states s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m.
S1.3.8 states both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, m<2^20 so log m<20, m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50, quoting line 1331.

S1.4.1 states the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clearing by lower-triangular elementary matrices, deleting the pivot row and column and repeating, giving exactly a ones, quoting line 1384.

S1.4's method works modulo 'a fixed odd prime power avoiding all denominators' of the fixed rational factorization; the invertibility of the triangular factors mod q is not spelled out but the defining device is stated.
S1.4 performs the triangular changes of coordinates by controlled shifts in descending coordinate order at O(V) further work, with the motivation that the target must follow its controls.
S1.4.2 states each one of Pi is implemented by D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, yielding (h+d,d) with one interchange, a in all, quoting line 1432.
S3.4 names Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) with C_1=20 but never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu or C_0=128mB^2.
The plan only says to 'bound the growth of the exact dyadic values' (S3 method); the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the leaf bound 8e and the per-invocation count below E do not appear.
No unrolling of the depth recurrence (B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, total below C_0 d^{C_1}) appears; S3.4 just asserts the depth is below Delta.

S3.4 states a depth-l value lies in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^l, that the guarded width represents every intermediate coefficient exactly, and that epsilon*C_1<1 gives Delta=o(p); the exact p+Delta / Delta+3 bit split is paraphrased rather than given.
S3.5 states every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^-p, quoting line 2751.

summary: P02 carries the bank exchange (B1-B4), the rank-saving arithmetic (R1-R4) and the matrix shear (M1-M4) fully, quoting the paper's own derivation lines. Of the label budget it has the telescoping (L3) and the loss ratios (L5) but not the residual table, the side-edge h-2 calculation or the orthonormal-basis argument. Of the phase interface it has only the column tensoring (P3): it asserts the translation-kernel form without the weight-mod-4 and odd-weight derivation, and gives the Z repair without the endpoint frames. Of the simultaneous layer it has the depth-to-precision step and the final truncation (S4, S5) but none of the constants, the depth recurrence or its unrolling (S1-S3). 17 of 26 present, none wrong.
